MORE:
Adcounty Media India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended on September 30, 2026.

Further, in accordance with the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 read with the Company's Code of Conduct to regulate, monitor and report trading by Designated Persons and their Immediate Relatives, the trading window of the Company has already been closed with effect from Thursday, October 01, 2026 and shall reopen after 48 hours from the declaration of the aforesaid financial results.
